card.name: Random code strings and 'per mL'
card.fires_on: Two kinds of spots: the unit mL right after 'mg per' when a concentration is given, and the middle of random-looking letter strings such as IDs, URLs or passwords.

modes.label: Concentration unit
modes.description: The word mL after 'mg per' in a stated concentration.
modes.example: final concentration of 10 mg per<< mL>>. Maximum daily dose is 10

modes.label: Random letter strings
modes.description: Capital-letter chunks inside codes, URL IDs, passwords or citation tags.
